name: JSON Grid
description: Explore and edit JSON as nested grids, DevTools-style trees and source. Copy JSONPath, search, filter and format locally.
releaseNotes: Remember each grid/tree tab independently: expansion, selection, search, filters, widths, sorting, page and scroll position. Preserve state during temporary invalid input; reset on a new document.

zh-CN.description: 将 JSON 转为可编辑嵌套网格与 DevTools 风格树形，支持路径复制、搜索筛选、格式化和撤销；数据在本地处理。
